mechanics.title: Re-authentication
mechanics.description: A button on the multiplayer screen starts Microsoft login (an offline login method also exists). The button position can be changed and dragged.

getting_started: If a server rejects you with a session error, use the Auth Me button on the Multiplayer screen to sign in again.
name: Auth Me
summary: Adds an authentication button to the multiplayer screen so you can log in to your Microsoft account again and re-validate an expired session, avoiding the invalid session error when joining servers.
